Reasoning: The stem states that at this time the sea-land pressure difference at this latitude reaches the largest of the year, indicating that the amplitude of seasonal pressure change needs to be judged from the thermal differences between sea and land. Place 1 is closer to a continent, and place 2 is closer to an ocean, so the seasonal fluctuation in pressure at place 2 is smaller.

The figure is a "sea-level pressure distribution map along the 30° latitude line in a certain month"; at this time, the sea-land pressure difference at this latitude is the largest of the year.

<image1>

Comparing places 1 and 2 in the figure, which place has smaller seasonal fluctuation in pressure?

method.method_draft: First describe the graph: it is a sea-level pressure curve along 30° latitude with labeled points 1 and 2 at different longitudes. Locate point 1 near a continental longitude and point 2 near an oceanic longitude. From the text, compare seasonal pressure fluctuation at these two places. Apply the land-sea thermal contrast rule: land areas have larger annual pressure swings, ocean areas have smaller annual pressure swings. Therefore point 2 has the smaller seasonal pressure fluctuation.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是沿30°纬线的某月海平面气压分布曲线，纵轴为气压/hPa，横轴为经度。曲线上标有1、2两地，其中1地大致位于60°E—90°E附近，处在大陆经度范围；2地大致位于180°附近，处在大洋经度范围。
推理：题干说明此时该纬度上海陆气压差值达到一年中最大，说明需要从海陆热力差异判断气压季节变化幅度。陆地受热、冷却快，气压随季节变化较大；海洋热容量大，升温降温慢，气压季节波动较小。1地偏大陆，2地偏海洋，因此2地的气压季节波动较小。
